```{r}
pm_size = as.numeric(sub("^[A-Za-z]+", "", prefix))
if (is.na(pm_size)) pm_size = 1500
```


## TSS +/- `r pm_size`bp


This section defines the genomic coordinates used throughout the analysis.

```{r tss}

feat = read.table(paste0("datashare/genomes/", species, "/", annotation, "/", version, "/Annotation/Genes/genes.bed"), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
feat$tss = ifelse(feat[,6]=="+", feat[,2], feat[,3])
feat[,2] = feat$tss  - pm_size
feat[feat[,2]<1,2] = 1
feat[,3] = feat[,2] + pm_size + pm_size
feat = feat[,1:6]

head(feat)
dim(feat)
```
